name: Socks
summary: Pair of crew socks laid in an L with a ribbed cuff, coloured heel and toe; for laundry and clothing scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the sole of the foot rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the pair is about 480 px wide and 470 px tall; use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: wiggle = the pair sways a little; bob = the pair bounces
